newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak cbank sets one-week repo, min rate 8.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Slovak cbank sets one-week repo, min rate 8.8 pct.

text.p: The National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) set a one-week repo tender on Monday to add liquidity of up to a maximum of one billion crowns ($29.6 million).
The minimum rate in the American-style tender was set at 8.8 percent, equal to the discount rate, a central bank statement said.
The NBS did not hold any refinancing repo tenders last week because market liquidity was sufficient to allow banks to meet their minimum reserves requirements on Friday.
According to NBS figures, the Slovak banking sector as of August 17 lacked 2.42 percent of the cumulative volume of funds needed to meet minimum reserves requirements later this month.
The daily volume of minimum reserves for commercial banks totals 36.817 billion crowns. The current reserve period ends August 31.
